hint_ladder: Say that someone found the answer to a problem after thinking about it.
Use work plus out, and put a pronoun object between them: work it out.
Start with the words: We finally worked ___ why the machine stopped.
teaching_content.reveal_form: We finally worked out why the machine stopped.
canonical_forms: We finally worked out why the machine stopped.
alternative_realizations: I need to work out how to open this file.
